description: This file defines Data Access Objects (DAOs) for a fitness tracking app, providing methods to insert and observe data related to workouts and daily steps using Room persistence library.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a WorkoutEntity into the database, replacing on conflict.

methods.name: observeAll
methods.description: Returns a flow of all WorkoutEntity records ordered by date descending.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts or updates a StepsEntity into the database, replacing on conflict.

methods.name: observeForDate
methods.description: Returns a flow with the StepsEntity for a specific date, if exists.
